<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Config;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Checks a decoded YAML document against one of the shipped JSON schemas.
 *
 * It implements the keywords those schemas use: $ref, allOf, type, const,
 * enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, propertyNames, items,
 * minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, minLength and pattern. The first
 * problem stops validation and is reported with its path and how to fix it.
 */
final class SchemaValidator
{
    /**
     * Creates a validator over the shipped schemas, or over another catalog.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?SchemaCatalog $catalog = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Validates a whole document against a named schema.
     *
     * @param mixed $document
     * @throws LintException when the document departs from the schema
     */
    public function validate($document, string $schemaName, string $file): void
    {
        $catalog = $this->catalog ?? new SchemaCatalog();
        $this->check($document, $catalog->schema($schemaName), $catalog->schema($schemaName), $catalog, $file, '');
    }

    /**
     * Validates one value against one schema node.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root the schema document the node belongs to, for local references
     * @throws LintException when the value departs from the node
     */
    public function check($value, array $schema, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['$ref']) && is_string($schema['$ref'])) {
            [$resolved, $resolvedRoot] = $this->resolve($schema['$ref'], $root, $catalog);
            $this->check($value, $resolved, $resolvedRoot, $catalog, $file, $path);
        }
        foreach ($this->list($schema['allOf'] ?? null) as $member) {
            $this->check($value, $this->object($member), $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
        }
        $this->checkScalar($value, $schema, $file, $path);
        if (is_array($value)) {
            $this->checkObject($value, $schema, $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
            $this->checkList($value, $schema, $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies the keywords that concern the value itself: type, const, enum, bounds, length and pattern.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @throws LintException when the value departs from the node
     */
    public function checkScalar($value, array $schema, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['type']) && !$this->hasType($value, $this->types($schema['type']))) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be %s, not %s', $this->describeTypes($this->types($schema['type'])), $this->describe($value)), sprintf('Change the value to %s.', $this->describeTypes($this->types($schema['type']))));
        }
        if (array_key_exists('const', $schema) && $value !== $schema['const']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, 'must be ' . $this->describe($schema['const']), sprintf('Set it to %s.', $this->describe($schema['const'])));
        }
        if (isset($schema['enum']) && !in_array($value, $this->list($schema['enum']), true)) {
            $allowed = implode(', ', array_map(fn ($entry): string => $this->describe($entry), $this->list($schema['enum'])));
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, 'must be one of ' . $allowed . ', not ' . $this->describe($value), 'Replace it with one of those values.');
        }
        if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) {
            $this->checkBounds($value, $schema, $file, $path);
        }
        if (is_string($value)) {
            $this->checkString($value, $schema, $file, $path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies minimum and maximum to a number.
     *
     * @param int|float $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @throws LintException when the number is out of bounds
     */
    public function checkBounds($value, array $schema, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['minimum']) && is_numeric($schema['minimum']) && $value < $schema['minimum']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be at least %s, not %s', $this->describe($schema['minimum']), $this->describe($value)), 'Raise the value.');
        }
        if (isset($schema['maximum']) && is_numeric($schema['maximum']) && $value > $schema['maximum']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be at most %s, not %s', $this->describe($schema['maximum']), $this->describe($value)), 'Lower the value.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies minLength and pattern to a string.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @throws LintException when the string is too short or does not match
     */
    public function checkString(string $value, array $schema, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['minLength']) && is_int($schema['minLength']) && strlen($value) < $schema['minLength']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, $schema['minLength'] === 1 ? 'must not be empty' : sprintf('must be at least %d characters long', $schema['minLength']), 'Write a value.');
        }
        if (isset($schema['pattern']) && is_string($schema['pattern']) && preg_match('#' . str_replace('#', '\#', $schema['pattern']) . '#', $value) !== 1) {
            $expected = isset($schema['description']) && is_string($schema['description']) ? $schema['description'] : 'a value matching ' . $schema['pattern'];
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be %s, not %s', $expected, $this->describe($value)), 'Change the value.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies required, properties, additionalProperties and propertyNames to a mapping.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root
     * @throws LintException when a key is missing, unknown, misnamed or invalid
     */
    public function checkObject(array $value, array $schema, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        $properties = $this->object($schema['properties'] ?? null);
        foreach ($this->list($schema['required'] ?? null) as $required) {
            if (is_string($required) && !array_key_exists($required, $value)) {
                $description = $this->object($properties[$required] ?? null)['description'] ?? null;
                throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('is missing the key "%s"', $required), 'Add it' . (is_string($description) ? ': ' . lcfirst($description) : '.'));
            }
        }
        if ($properties === [] && !isset($schema['additionalProperties']) && !isset($schema['propertyNames'])) {
            return;
        }
        foreach ($value as $key => $entry) {
            $key = (string) $key;
            $childPath = $path === '' ? $key : $path . '.' . $key;
            if (isset($properties[$key])) {
                $this->check($entry, $this->object($properties[$key]), $root, $catalog, $file, $childPath);
                continue;
            }
            if (isset($schema['propertyNames'])) {
                $this->checkPropertyName($key, $this->object($schema['propertyNames']), $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
            }
            $additional = $schema['additionalProperties'] ?? true;
            if ($additional === false) {
                throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('has the unknown key "%s"', $key), 'Remove it or rename it to one of: ' . implode(', ', array_keys($properties)) . '.');
            }
            if (is_array($additional)) {
                $this->check($entry, $this->object($additional), $root, $catalog, $file, $childPath);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Validates one key of a mapping against the propertyNames node, rephrasing the failure around the key.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root
     * @throws LintException when the key is not allowed
     */
    public function checkPropertyName(string $key, array $schema, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        try {
            $this->check($key, $schema, $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
        } catch (LintException $exception) {
            [$resolved] = isset($schema['$ref']) && is_string($schema['$ref']) ? $this->resolve($schema['$ref'], $root, $catalog) : [$schema, $root];
            $expected = isset($resolved['description']) && is_string($resolved['description']) ? $resolved['description'] : 'a valid key';
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('has the key "%s", which is not %s', $key, $expected), 'Rename the key.', $exception);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies minItems, maxItems and items to a list.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root
     * @throws LintException when the list has the wrong length or an invalid entry
     */
    public function checkList(array $value, array $schema, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['minItems']) && is_int($schema['minItems']) && count($value) < $schema['minItems']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must have at least %d %s, not %d', $schema['minItems'], $schema['minItems'] === 1 ? 'entry' : 'entries', count($value)), 'Add entries.');
        }
        if (isset($schema['maxItems']) && is_int($schema['maxItems']) && count($value) > $schema['maxItems']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must have at most %d entries, not %d', $schema['maxItems'], count($value)), 'Remove entries.');
        }
        if (!isset($schema['items']) || array_values($value) !== $value) {
            return;
        }
        foreach ($value as $index => $entry) {
            $this->check($entry, $this->object($schema['items']), $root, $catalog, $file, $path . '[' . $index . ']');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Resolves a reference of the form #/$defs/name or file.schema.json#/$defs/name.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root
     * @return array{0: array<string, mixed>, 1: array<string, mixed>} the referenced node and the document it lives in
     * @throws LintException when the reference points nowhere
     */
    public function resolve(string $reference, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog): array
    {
        [$document, $pointer] = array_pad(explode('#', $reference, 2), 2, '');
        if ($document !== '') {
            $root = $catalog->schema((string) preg_replace('/\.schema\.json$/', '', $document));
        }
        $node = $root;
        foreach (array_filter(explode('/', $pointer), static fn (string $segment): bool => $segment !== '') as $segment) {
            $node = $this->object($node[$segment] ?? null);
            if ($node === []) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('Schema reference "%s" points to nothing. Reinstall decisions-lint so its schema directory is complete.', $reference));
            }
        }

        return [$node, $root];
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a value has one of the JSON types; an empty array counts as both an object and an array.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @param list<string> $types
     */
    public function hasType($value, array $types): bool
    {
        foreach ($types as $type) {
            $matches = match ($type) {
                'object' => is_array($value) && ($value === [] || array_values($value) !== $value),
                'array' => is_array($value) && array_values($value) === $value,
                'string' => is_string($value),
                'integer' => is_int($value),
                'number' => is_int($value) || is_float($value),
                'boolean' => is_bool($value),
                'null' => $value === null,
                default => false,
            };
            if ($matches) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the exception for one problem: the file, the path, what is wrong and what to do.
     */
    public function problem(string $file, string $path, string $what, string $fix, ?LintException $previous = null): LintException
    {
        return new LintException(sprintf('%s: %s %s. %s', $file, $path === '' ? 'the document' : $path, $what, $fix), 0, $previous);
    }

    /**
     * Describes a value for a message: strings quoted, scalars as PHP writes them, arrays by shape.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     */
    public function describe($value): string
    {
        if (is_string($value)) {
            return '"' . $value . '"';
        }
        if (is_array($value)) {
            return $value === [] ? 'an empty list' : (array_values($value) === $value ? 'a list' : 'a mapping');
        }

        return var_export($value, true);
    }

    /**
     * Names one or more JSON types the way a reader would, such as "a string" or "true or false".
     *
     * @param list<string> $types
     */
    public function describeTypes(array $types): string
    {
        $names = [];
        foreach ($types as $type) {
            $names[] = match ($type) {
                'object' => 'a mapping',
                'array' => 'a list',
                'string' => 'a string',
                'integer' => 'an integer',
                'number' => 'a number',
                'boolean' => 'true or false',
                default => $type,
            };
        }

        return implode(' or ', $names);
    }

    /**
     * Reads a type keyword, which is one type or a list of types, as a list.
     *
     * @param mixed $type
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function types($type): array
    {
        $types = [];
        foreach (is_array($type) ? $type : [$type] as $entry) {
            if (is_string($entry)) {
                $types[] = $entry;
            }
        }

        return $types;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a schema keyword that holds a mapping, or an empty mapping.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function object($value): array
    {
        $object = [];
        foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [] as $key => $entry) {
            $object[(string) $key] = $entry;
        }

        return $object;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a schema keyword that holds a list, or an empty list.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @return list<mixed>
     */
    public function list($value): array
    {
        return is_array($value) ? array_values($value) : [];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Config;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use Symfony\Component\Yaml\Exception\ParseException;
use Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml;

/**
 * Reads one YAML document and checks it against its schema before anything else looks at it.
 */
final class DocumentLoader
{
    /**
     * Creates a loader, optionally with a shared validator.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?SchemaValidator $validator = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the mapping a file holds once it passes the named schema.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     * @throws LintException when the file is missing, not YAML, or departs from the schema
     */
    public function load(string $path, string $schemaName, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_file($path)) {
            $hint = $schemaName === SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS ? 'Run decisions-lint init to create it, or pass --config.' : 'Check that the path is relative to the file that imports it.';
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s not found: %s. %s', $schemaName === SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS ? 'Configuration' : 'Rule file', $path, $hint));
        }
        try {
            $document = Yaml::parseFile($path);
        } catch (ParseException $exception) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s is not valid YAML: %s. Correct the YAML syntax.', $label, $exception->getMessage()), 0, $exception);
        }
        ($this->validator ?? new SchemaValidator())->validate($document, $schemaName, $label);
        $mapping = [];
        foreach (is_array($document) ? $document : [] as $key => $value) {
            $mapping[(string) $key] = $value;
        }

        return $mapping;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Config;

/**
 * Lays a partial rule definition over a complete one.
 *
 * Mappings merge key by key, so an override that sets only `decision.threshold`
 * keeps the imported instructions. Lists and scalars replace the imported
 * value, so an override that sets `violations` or `paths` writes the whole list.
 */
final class DocumentMerger
{
    /**
     * Returns the base with every key of the override applied.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $base
     * @param array<string, mixed> $override
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function merge(array $base, array $override): array
    {
        foreach ($override as $key => $value) {
            $existing = $base[$key] ?? null;
            $base[$key] = is_array($value) && is_array($existing) && $this->isMapping($value) && $this->isMapping($existing)
                ? $this->merge($this->mapping($existing), $this->mapping($value))
                : $value;
        }

        return $base;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a non-empty array has string keys.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     */
    public function isMapping(array $value): bool
    {
        return $value !== [] && array_values($value) !== $value;
    }

    /**
     * Returns an array with its keys as strings.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function mapping(array $value): array
    {
        $mapping = [];
        foreach ($value as $key => $entry) {
            $mapping[(string) $key] = $entry;
        }

        return $mapping;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Config;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Loads decisions.yaml, the rule files it imports, and lays the project's rule overrides over them.
 *
 * Imports are read in order and a later file overrides an earlier definition
 * of the same rule id. The rules written in decisions.yaml override all of them.
 */
final class ImportResolver
{
    /**
     * Creates a resolver, optionally with shared collaborators.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?DocumentLoader $loader = null, private ?DocumentMerger $merger = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the configuration document with its `rules` replaced by the merged rule definitions.
     *
     * Every merged rule carries a `source` key naming the files that defined it, for messages.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     * @throws LintException when a file is missing, malformed, or departs from its schema
     */
    public function resolve(string $configPath): array
    {
        $loader = $this->loader ?? new DocumentLoader();
        $document = $loader->load($configPath, SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS, basename($configPath));
        $directory = dirname($configPath);
        $rules = [];
        foreach ($this->strings($document['imports'] ?? null) as $import) {
            $path = str_starts_with($import, '/') ? $import : $directory . '/' . $import;
            $file = $loader->load($path, SchemaCatalog::RULES, $import);
            $rules = $this->overlay($rules, $this->mapping($file['rules'] ?? null), $import);
        }
        $document['rules'] = $this->overlay($rules, $this->mapping($document['rules'] ?? null), basename($configPath));

        return $document;
    }

    /**
     * Lays every rule of a file over the rules collected so far.
     *
     * @param array<string, array<string, mixed>> $rules
     * @param array<string, mixed> $definitions
     * @return array<string, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function overlay(array $rules, array $definitions, string $source): array
    {
        $merger = $this->merger ?? new DocumentMerger();
        foreach ($definitions as $id => $definition) {
            $existing = $rules[$id] ?? ['source' => []];
            $merged = $merger->merge($existing, $this->mapping($definition));
            $merged['source'] = array_merge($this->strings($existing['source'] ?? null), [$source]);
            $rules[$id] = $merged;
        }

        return $rules;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a value as a mapping with string keys, or an empty mapping.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function mapping($value): array
    {
        $mapping = [];
        foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [] as $key => $entry) {
            $mapping[(string) $key] = $entry;
        }

        return $mapping;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a value as a list of strings, or an empty list.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function strings($value): array
    {
        $strings = [];
        foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [] as $entry) {
            if (is_string($entry)) {
                $strings[] = $entry;
            }
        }

        return $strings;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Config;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Severity;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\DecisionSpec;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\TargetSelector;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Template;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Violation;

/**
 * Turns one merged rule definition into a Rule, checking what the schema cannot: that the parts fit each other.
 */
final class RuleReader
{
    /**
     * Creates a reader, optionally with a shared template checker.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Template $template = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Builds the rule with an id from its merged definition.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $definition
     * @throws LintException when a required part is missing or the parts contradict each other
     */
    public function read(string $id, array $definition): Rule
    {
        $context = sprintf('Rule "%s" (%s)', $id, implode(', ', $this->strings($definition['source'] ?? null)));
        foreach (['target', 'decision', 'violations'] as $key) {
            if (!array_key_exists($key, $definition)) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('%s has no %s. Add it, or import the rule file that defines the rule before overriding it in decisions.yaml.', $context, $key));
            }
        }
        $decision = $this->decision($this->mapping($definition['decision']), $context);
        $violations = [];
        foreach ($this->list($definition['violations']) as $index => $violation) {
            $violations[] = $this->violation($this->mapping($violation), $decision, $context . '.violations[' . $index . ']');
        }
        $severity = $definition['severity'] ?? Severity::ERROR;
        $contextMode = $definition['context'] ?? 'class';

        return new Rule(
            $id,
            is_string($definition['description'] ?? null) ? $definition['description'] : '',
            is_string($severity) ? $severity : Severity::ERROR,
            ($definition['enabled'] ?? true) !== false,
            $this->strings($definition['paths'] ?? null),
            $this->strings($definition['exclude'] ?? null),
            $this->target($this->mapping($definition['target'])),
            is_string($contextMode) ? $contextMode : 'class',
            $decision,
            $violations,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Builds the selector of a rule.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $target
     */
    public function target(array $target): TargetSelector
    {
        $kind = $target['kind'] ?? 'file';
        $static = $target['static'] ?? null;

        return new TargetSelector(is_string($kind) ? $kind : 'file', $this->strings($target['visibility'] ?? null), $this->strings($target['names'] ?? null), $this->strings($target['exclude_names'] ?? null), is_bool($static) ? $static : null);
    }

    /**
     * Builds the decision of a rule, requiring the options a choice or the levels a score needs.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $decision
     * @throws LintException when the type is missing, the instructions are missing, or the type lacks its options or levels
     */
    public function decision(array $decision, string $context): DecisionSpec
    {
        $type = $decision['type'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($type)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: decision.type is missing. Set it to predicate, choice or score.', $context));
        }
        $instructions = $decision['instructions'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($instructions) || trim($instructions) === '') {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: decision.instructions is missing. Write the question the model answers about each target.', $context));
        }
        $template = $this->template ?? new Template();
        $template->check($instructions, $context . ': decision.instructions');
        $choices = [];
        foreach ($this->mapping($decision['choices'] ?? null) as $name => $description) {
            $choices[$name] = is_string($description) ? $description : '';
        }
        $levels = $this->strings($decision['levels'] ?? null);
        if ($type === Question::CHOICE && count($choices) < 2) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: decision.choices must list at least 2 options when decision.type is choice. Add the options as name: description pairs.', $context));
        }
        if ($type === Question::SCORE && count($levels) < 2) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: decision.levels must list at least 2 levels when decision.type is score. Add the level descriptions from lowest to highest.', $context));
        }
        $threshold = $decision['threshold'] ?? 0.5;

        return new DecisionSpec($type, $instructions, $choices, $levels, is_int($threshold) || is_float($threshold) ? (float) $threshold : 0.5);
    }

    /**
     * Builds one violation, requiring the answer form the decision type uses.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $violation
     * @throws LintException when the answer does not fit the decision type or a template is invalid
     */
    public function violation(array $violation, DecisionSpec $decision, string $context): Violation
    {
        $answer = $violation['answer'] ?? null;
        $minScore = $violation['min_score'] ?? null;
        $maxScore = $violation['max_score'] ?? null;
        if ($decision->type === Question::PREDICATE && !is_bool($answer)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: answer must be true or false for a predicate decision. Set answer to the boolean answer that violates the rule.', $context));
        }
        if ($decision->type === Question::CHOICE && (!is_string($answer) || !array_key_exists($answer, $decision->choices))) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: answer must name one of the decision.choices (%s). Set answer to the option that violates the rule.', $context, implode(', ', array_keys($decision->choices))));
        }
        if ($decision->type === Question::SCORE && $minScore === null && $maxScore === null) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: set min_score, max_score or both for a score decision. Scores run from 0 to %d.', $context, count($decision->levels) - 1));
        }
        $message = $violation['message'] ?? null;
        $fix = $violation['fix'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($message) || !is_string($fix)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s: message and fix are required. Write what is wrong in message and what to change in fix.', $context));
        }
        $template = $this->template ?? new Template();
        $template->check($message, $context . '.message');
        $template->check($fix, $context . '.fix');

        return new Violation(is_bool($answer) || is_string($answer) ? $answer : null, is_numeric($minScore) ? (float) $minScore : null, is_numeric($maxScore) ? (float) $maxScore : null, $message, $fix);
    }

    /**
     * Reads a value as a mapping with string keys, or an empty mapping.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function mapping($value): array
    {
        $mapping = [];
        foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [] as $key => $entry) {
            $mapping[(string) $key] = $entry;
        }

        return $mapping;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a value as a list, or an empty list.

        $strings = [];
        foreach (is_array($value) ? $value : [] as $entry) {

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Lint;

use DecisionsLint\Config\Configuration;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\QuestionBuilder;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule;
use DecisionsLint\Source\FileFinder;
use DecisionsLint\Source\GlobMatcher;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;
use DecisionsLint\Source\TargetExtractor;

/**
 * Works out which rules apply to which declarations and groups the questions per target.
 *
 * Every rule that judges the same declaration with the same context shares one
 * inquiry, so the model reads the source once and answers every question in
 * one request.
 */
final class Planner
{
    /**
     * Creates a planner, optionally with shared collaborators.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?TargetExtractor $extractor = null, private ?QuestionBuilder $questions = null, private ?GlobMatcher $matcher = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Plans a run over the configured paths, or over the given paths, with the enabled rules, or the given rule ids.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds
     * @throws LintException when a path does not exist, a file cannot be read, or a rule id is unknown
     */
    public function plan(Configuration $configuration, array $paths = [], array $ruleIds = []): Plan
    {
        $rules = $this->rules($configuration, $ruleIds);
        $files = (new FileFinder($configuration->directory, $this->matcher))->find($paths === [] ? $configuration->paths : $paths, $configuration->exclude);
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            foreach ($this->candidates($file, $configuration->directory, $this->applicable($rules, $file)) as $candidate) {
                $key = $candidate['target']->file . '|' . $candidate['target']->qualifiedName . '|' . $candidate['target']->line . '|' . $candidate['target']->kind . '|' . $candidate['rule']->context;
                $groups[$key] ??= ['target' => $candidate['target'], 'context' => $candidate['rule']->context, 'rules' => []];
                $groups[$key]['rules'][] = $candidate['rule'];
            }
        }
        $builder = $this->questions ?? new QuestionBuilder();
        $inquiries = [];
        $assignments = [];
        foreach (array_values($groups) as $index => $group) {
            $inquiries[] = $builder->inquiry($group['target'], $group['context'], $group['rules']);
            foreach ($group['rules'] as $rule) {
                $assignments[] = new Assignment($index, $rule, $group['target']);
            }
        }

        return new Plan($files, $inquiries, $assignments);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rules to run, rejecting an id the configuration does not define.
     *
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds
     * @return list<Rule>
     * @throws LintException when a requested id matches no rule
     */
    public function rules(Configuration $configuration, array $ruleIds): array
    {
        $known = array_map(static fn (Rule $rule): string => $rule->id, $configuration->rules);
        foreach ($ruleIds as $id) {
            if (!in_array($id, $known, true)) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('Unknown rule "%s". Use one of the configured rule ids: %s.', $id, $known === [] ? '(none)' : implode(', ', $known)));
            }
        }

        return $configuration->activeRules($ruleIds);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rules whose path globs select a file.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     * @return list<Rule>
     */
    public function applicable(array $rules, string $file): array
    {
        $matcher = $this->matcher ?? new GlobMatcher();
        $applicable = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if (($rule->paths === [] || $matcher->matchesAny($rule->paths, $file)) && !$matcher->matchesAny($rule->exclude, $file)) {
                $applicable[] = $rule;
            }
        }

        return $applicable;
    }

    /**
     * Returns every rule-and-target pair of one file.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     * @return list<array{rule: Rule, target: Target}>
     * @throws LintException when the file cannot be read
     */
    public function candidates(string $file, string $directory, array $rules): array
    {
        if ($rules === []) {
            return [];
        }
        $code = file_get_contents($directory . '/' . $file);
        if ($code === false) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not read %s. Check the file permissions.', $directory . '/' . $file));
        }
        $extractor = $this->extractor ?? new TargetExtractor();
        $declarations = null;
        $candidates = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if ($rule->target->kind === Target::FILE) {
                $candidates[] = ['rule' => $rule, 'target' => $extractor->file($file, $code)];
                continue;
            }
            if (!str_ends_with(strtolower($file), '.php')) {
                continue;
            }
            $declarations ??= $extractor->extract($file, $code);
            foreach ($declarations as $target) {
                if ($rule->target->selects($target)) {
                    $candidates[] = ['rule' => $rule, 'target' => $target];
                }
            }
        }

        return $candidates;
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Lint;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Severity;

/**
 * The outcome of a run: the findings and the numbers that put them in proportion.
 *
 * @property-read list<Finding> $findings the findings sorted by file, line, column and rule
 * @property-read int $files how many files were read
 * @property-read int $targets how many declarations were judged
 * @property-read int $requests how many requests the provider answered
 * @property-read list<string> $models the model versions that answered
 * @property-read string $failOn the weakest severity that fails the run, or never
 */
final class Report
{
    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param list<Finding> $findings
     * @param list<string> $models
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private array $findings,
        /** @readonly */
        private int $files,
        /** @readonly */
        private int $targets,
        /** @readonly */
        private int $requests,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $models,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $failOn,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns a declared immutable property.
     *
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'findings' => $this->findings,
            'files' => $this->files,
            'targets' => $this->targets,
            'requests' => $this->requests,
            'models' => $this->models,
            'failOn' => $this->failOn,
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Returns how many findings each severity has.
     *
     * @return array{error: int, warning: int, info: int}
     */
    public function counts(): array
    {
        $counts = ['error' => 0, 'warning' => 0, 'info' => 0];
        foreach ($this->findings as $finding) {
            if (array_key_exists($finding->severity, $counts)) {
                ++$counts[$finding->severity];
            }
        }

        return $counts;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a finding is at least as severe as the configured threshold.
     */
    public function failed(): bool
    {
        $severity = new Severity();
        foreach ($this->findings as $finding) {
            if ($severity->atLeast($finding->severity, $this->failOn)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Returns how many distinct files have findings.
     */
    public function filesWithFindings(): int
    {
        $paths = [];
        foreach ($this->findings as $finding) {
            $paths[$finding->path] = true;
        }

        return count($paths);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Lint;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\ViolationMatcher;

/**
 * Sends a plan to the decision model and turns its answers into findings.
 */
final class Linter
{
    /**
     * Creates a linter, optionally with a shared matcher.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?ViolationMatcher $matcher = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Runs the plan against a decision and reports what violates the rules.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the provider rejects a request or cannot be reached
     */
    public function lint(Plan $plan, Decision $decision, string $failOn): Report
    {
        $verdicts = $plan->inquiries === [] ? [] : $decision->decide($plan->inquiries);
        $matcher = $this->matcher ?? new ViolationMatcher();
        $findings = [];
        $models = [];
        foreach ($plan->assignments as $assignment) {
            $verdict = $verdicts[$assignment->inquiry];
            $models[$verdict->model] = true;
            $finding = $matcher->match($assignment->rule, $assignment->target, $verdict->answer($assignment->rule->id));
            if ($finding !== null) {
                $findings[] = $finding;
            }
        }

        return new Report($this->sort($findings), count($plan->files), $plan->targets(), count($verdicts), array_keys($models), $failOn);
    }

    /**
     * Orders findings by file, line, column and rule.
     *
     * @param list<Finding> $findings
     * @return list<Finding>
     */
    public function sort(array $findings): array
    {
        usort($findings, static fn (Finding $a, Finding $b): int => [$a->path, $a->line, $a->column, $a->rule] <=> [$b->path, $b->line, $b->column, $b->rule]);

        return $findings;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Reporting;

use DecisionsLint\Lint\Report;

/**
 * The closing lines every text-like format shares: the counts and whether the run passed.
 */
final class Summary
{
    /**
     * Returns the counts joined by a separator, such as "1 error, 2 warnings, 0 infos, 2 files with findings, 14 targets, 9 requests to jev-1.13.0".
     */
    public function counts(Report $report, string $separator): string
    {
        $counts = $report->counts();
        $files = $report->filesWithFindings();
        $parts = [
            $this->plural($counts['error'], 'error', 'errors'),
            $this->plural($counts['warning'], 'warning', 'warnings'),
            $this->plural($counts['info'], 'info', 'infos'),
            $this->plural($files, 'file', 'files') . ' with findings',
            $this->plural($report->targets, 'target', 'targets'),
            $this->plural($report->requests, 'request', 'requests') . ($report->models === [] ? '' : ' to ' . implode(', ', $report->models)),
        ];

        return implode($separator, $parts);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the verdict line of a run.
     */
    public function verdict(Report $report): string
    {
        return $report->failed()
            ? sprintf('Decisions check failed: a finding is at least %s and fail_on is %s.', $report->failOn, $report->failOn)
            : 'Decisions check passed.';
    }

    /**
     * Joins a count with its singular or plural noun.
     */
    public function plural(int $count, string $singular, string $plural): string
    {
        return $count . ' ' . ($count === 1 ? $singular : $plural);
    }
}

    public function __construct(private ?Summary $summary = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the report grouped by file, each finding with its position, rule, symbol, message and fix.
     */
    public function render(Report $report, bool $decorated): string
    {
        $formatter = new OutputFormatter($decorated);
        $summary = $this->summary ?? new Summary();
        $lines = ['', '<options=bold>Decisions check</>', ''];
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($report->findings as $finding) {
            $groups[$finding->path][] = $finding;
        }
        foreach ($groups as $path => $findings) {
            $lines[] = '<options=bold>' . OutputFormatter::escape((string) $path) . '</>';

                $color = $this->color($finding->severity);

    }

    /**
     * Returns the terminal colour of a severity.
     */
    public function color(string $severity): string
    {
        return match ($severity) {
            'error' => 'red',
            'warning' => 'yellow',
            default => 'blue',
        };
    }

namespace DecisionsLint\Reporting;

use DecisionsLint\Lint\Report;

/**
 * Renders the report as Checkstyle XML, which editors and CI systems already read.
 */
final class CheckstyleReporter implements Reporter
{
    /**
     * Returns a `checkstyle` document with one `file` element per path and one `error` element per finding.
     */
    public function render(Report $report, bool $decorated): string
    {
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($report->findings as $finding) {
            $groups[$finding->path][] = $finding;
        }
        $lines = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>', '<checkstyle version="decisions-lint">'];
        foreach ($groups as $path => $findings) {
            $lines[] = '  <file name="' . $this->escape((string) $path) . '">';
            foreach ($findings as $finding) {
                $lines[] = sprintf('    <error line="%d" column="%d" severity="%s" message="%s" source="%s"/>', $finding->line, $finding->column, $finding->severity, $this->escape($finding->message . ' Fix: ' . $finding->fix), $this->escape($finding->rule));
            }
            $lines[] = '  </file>';
        }
        $lines[] = '</checkstyle>';

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Escapes text for an XML attribute.
     */
    public function escape(string $text): string
    {
        return htmlspecialchars($text, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_XML1, 'UTF-8');
    }
}

/**
 * Renders the report as GitHub Actions workflow commands, so findings appear as annotations on the changed lines.

{

     * Creates a reporter, optionally with a shared summary.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Summary $summary = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns one `::error`, `::warning` or `::notice` command per finding, then the counts and the verdict as plain lines.
     */
    public function render(Report $report, bool $decorated): string
    {
        $summary = $this->summary ?? new Summary();
        $lines = [];
        foreach ($report->findings as $finding) {
            $command = match ($finding->severity) {
                'error' => 'error',
                'warning' => 'warning',
                default => 'notice',
            };
            $lines[] = sprintf('::%s file=%s,line=%d,col=%d,title=%s::%s', $command, $this->property($finding->path), $finding->line, $finding->column, $this->property($finding->rule), $this->data($finding->message . ' Fix: ' . $finding->fix));
        }
        $lines[] = $summary->counts($report, ', ') . '.';
        $lines[] = $summary->verdict($report);

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Escapes a command property value.
     */
    public function property(string $value): string
    {
        return strtr($value, ['%' => '%25', "\r" => '%0D', "\n" => '%0A', ':' => '%3A', ',' => '%2C']);
    }

    /**
     * Escapes the command message.
     */
    public function data(string $value): string
    {
        return strtr($value, ['%' => '%25', "\r" => '%0D', "\n" => '%0A']);
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Reporting;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Picks the reporter of an output format name.
 */
final class ReporterFactory
{
    /**
     * The formats --format accepts; human is an alias of text.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    public const FORMATS = ['text', 'human', 'ai', 'json', 'checkstyle', 'github'];

    /**
     * Returns the reporter for a format.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the format is not one of FORMATS
     */
    public function create(string $format): Reporter
    {
        return match ($format) {
            'text', 'human' => new TextReporter(),
            'ai' => new AiReporter(),
            'json' => new JsonReporter(),
            'checkstyle' => new CheckstyleReporter(),
            'github' => new GithubReporter(),
            default => throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --format "%s". Use --format=%s.', $format, implode(', ', self::FORMATS))),
        };
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Reporting;

use DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule;
use JsonException;

/**
 * Lists the effective rules after imports and overrides, as text or JSON.
 */
final class RuleCatalogReporter
{
    /**
     * Returns the rules in the requested format; text for every format but json.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     * @throws JsonException when a rule holds text that cannot be encoded
     */
    public function render(array $rules, string $format): string
    {
        if ($format === 'json') {
            $rows = [];
            foreach ($rules as $rule) {
                $rows[] = $this->row($rule);
            }

            return json_encode(['rules' => $rows, 'count' => count($rows)], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n";
        }
        $lines = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            $lines[] = sprintf('%s  %s  %s %s  %s%s', $rule->id, $rule->severity, $rule->target->kind, $rule->decision->type, $rule->enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled', $rule->paths === [] ? '' : '  ' . implode(',', $rule->paths));
            if ($rule->description !== '') {
                $lines[] = '  ' . $rule->description;
            }
        }
        $lines[] = sprintf('%d %s.', count($rules), count($rules) === 1 ? 'rule' : 'rules');

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Returns the JSON row of one rule.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function row(Rule $rule): array
    {
        $violations = [];
        foreach ($rule->violations as $violation) {
            $violations[] = ['answer' => $violation->answer, 'min_score' => $violation->minScore, 'max_score' => $violation->maxScore, 'message' => $violation->message, 'fix' => $violation->fix];
        }

        return [
            'id' => $rule->id,
            'description' => $rule->description,
            'severity' => $rule->severity,
            'enabled' => $rule->enabled,
            'paths' => $rule->paths,
            'exclude' => $rule->exclude,
            'target' => ['kind' => $rule->target->kind, 'visibility' => $rule->target->visibility, 'names' => $rule->target->names, 'exclude_names' => $rule->target->excludeNames, 'static' => $rule->target->static],
            'context' => $rule->context,
            'decision' => ['type' => $rule->decision->type, 'instructions' => $rule->decision->instructions, 'choices' => $rule->decision->choices, 'levels' => $rule->decision->levels, 'threshold' => $rule->decision->threshold],
            'violations' => $violations,
        ];
    }
}

    public function render(Plan $plan, string $format): string
    {
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($plan->assignments as $assignment) {
            $target = $assignment->target;
            $key = $assignment->inquiry;
            $groups[$key] ??= ['file' => $target->file, 'line' => $target->line, 'column' => $target->column, 'kind' => $target->kind, 'symbol' => $target->qualifiedName, 'context' => $assignment->rule->context, 'rules' => []];
            $groups[$key]['rules'][] = $assignment->rule->id;
        }
        $groups = array_values($groups);
        if ($format === 'json') {
            return json_encode(['requests' => $groups, 'files' => count($plan->files), 'targets' => $plan->targets(), 'questions' => count($plan->assignments)], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) . "\n";
        }
        $lines = [];
        foreach ($groups as $group) {
            $lines[] = sprintf('%s:%d:%d %s %s (%s) <- %s', $group['file'], $group['line'], $group['column'], $group['kind'], $group['symbol'], $group['context'], implode(', ', $group['rules']));
        }
        $lines[] = sprintf('%d files, %d targets, %d requests, %d questions. Nothing was sent.', count($plan->files), $plan->targets(), count($groups), count($plan->assignments));

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use Closure;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Formatter\OutputFormatterInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleSectionOutput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\Output;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Console output that hands every written message to a closure.
 *
 * It lets the console application write into a sink a caller injected, with
 * standard error kept apart when the caller gives one.
 */
final class ClosureOutput extends Output implements ConsoleOutputInterface
{
    /** @readonly */
    private Closure $sink;

    private OutputInterface $errorOutput;

    /**
     * Creates an output that writes to a sink, and its errors to another output.
     *
     * @param Closure(string): void $sink receives every written message
     * @param ?OutputInterface $errorOutput receives the errors, or null to keep them in this output
     */
    public function __construct(Closure $sink, ?OutputInterface $errorOutput = null)
    {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->sink = $sink;
        $this->errorOutput = $errorOutput ?? $this;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the output the errors are written to.
     */
    public function getErrorOutput(): OutputInterface
    {
        return $this->errorOutput;
    }

    /**
     * Replaces the output the errors are written to.
     */
    public function setErrorOutput(OutputInterface $error): void
    {
        $this->errorOutput = $error;
    }

    /**
     * Refuses sections, which need a terminal stream to redraw.
     *
     * @throws LintException always
     */
    public function section(): ConsoleSectionOutput
    {
        throw new LintException('Output sections need a terminal stream; write to the console output instead.');
    }

    /**
     * Sets the verbosity of this output and of its error output.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function setVerbosity(int $level): void
    {
        parent::setVerbosity($level);
        if ($this->errorOutput !== $this) {
            $this->errorOutput->setVerbosity($level);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Turns decoration on or off for this output and its error output.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function setDecorated(bool $decorated): void
    {
        parent::setDecorated($decorated);
        if ($this->errorOutput !== $this) {
            $this->errorOutput->setDecorated($decorated);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sets the formatter of this output and of its error output.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function setFormatter(OutputFormatterInterface $formatter): void
    {
        parent::setFormatter($formatter);
        if ($this->errorOutput !== $this) {
            $this->errorOutput->setFormatter($formatter);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Hands one formatted message to the sink.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function doWrite(string $message, bool $newline): void
    {
        ($this->sink)($newline ? $message . "\n" : $message);
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

/**
 * Detects agent sessions using the same markers as the toolkit reporters.
 */
final class FormatDetector
{
    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    private const MARKERS = [
        'AI_AGENT', 'CLAUDE_CODE', 'CLAUDECODE', 'CURSOR_TRACE_ID', 'CURSOR_AGENT',
        'GEMINI_CLI', 'CODEX_SANDBOX', 'CODEX_THREAD_ID', 'AUGMENT_AGENT', 'OPENCODE',
        'DEVIN', 'WINDSURF_SESSION_ID', 'AIDER', 'CLINE', 'CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR',
    ];

    /**
     * Returns the compact agent format or the human format for this invocation.
     */
    public function detect(): string
    {
        foreach (self::MARKERS as $marker) {
            $value = getenv($marker);
            if ($value !== false && ($marker !== 'AI_AGENT' || trim($value) !== '')) {
                return 'ai';
            }
        }

        return is_file('/opt/.devin') || is_dir('/opt/.devin') ? 'ai' : 'text';
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Cli\FormatDetector;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Reporting\ReporterFactory;
use JsonException;
use Override;
use RuntimeException;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Completion\CompletionInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Completion\CompletionSuggestions;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Exception\ExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * A decisions-lint console command: shared options, error reporting and exit codes.
 *
 * Every failure is reported in one line on standard error that names the
 * problem and how to fix it, and exits 2, so a caller can tell a broken
 * command line, configuration or provider apart from a violated rule, which exits 1.
 */
abstract class LintCommand extends Command
{
    /**
     * The configuration a command reads when --config is not given.
     */
    public const DEFAULT_CONFIG = 'decisions.yaml';

    /**
     * The exit code of an invalid command line, configuration, rule file or provider response.
     */
    public const INVALID = 2;

    /**
     * Creates a command that works on one project directory.
     *
     * @param ?Transport $transport the transport to reach the provider with, or null for cURL
     */
    public function __construct(private string $directory, string $name, private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($name);
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command, reporting a command line it cannot read.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function run(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        try {
            return parent::run($input, $output);
        } catch (ExceptionInterface $exception) {
            $this->error($output, $exception->getMessage(), sprintf('Run "decisions-lint %s --help" to see its options.', $this->getName() ?? ''));

            return self::INVALID;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Suggests the values of the options every command shares.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function complete(CompletionInput $input, CompletionSuggestions $suggestions): void
    {
        if ($input->mustSuggestOptionValuesFor('format')) {
            $suggestions->suggestValues(ReporterFactory::FORMATS);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the project directory the command works on.
     */
    public function directory(): string
    {
        return $this->directory;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the injected transport, or null when the provider is reached over cURL.
     */
    public function transport(): ?Transport
    {
        return $this->transport;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the absolute path of the configuration --config names.
     *
     * @throws LintException when --config was given an empty value
     */
    public function configPath(InputInterface $input): string
    {
        $config = $input->getOption('config');
        if (!is_string($config) || $config === '') {
            throw new LintException('Provide a non-empty --config path, such as --config=decisions.yaml.');
        }

        return str_starts_with($config, '/') ? $config : $this->directory . '/' . $config;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the output format --format names, or the one the session suggests.
     *
     * @param list<string> $allowed the formats this command supports
     * @throws LintException when the format is not supported
     */
    public function format(InputInterface $input, array $allowed): string
    {
        $format = $input->getOption('format');
        if ($format === null) {
            $detected = (new FormatDetector())->detect();

            return in_array($detected, $allowed, true) ? $detected : 'text';
        }
        if (!is_string($format) || !in_array($format, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --format "%s". Use --format=%s.', is_string($format) ? $format : '', implode(', ', $allowed)));
        }

        return $format;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rule ids --rule names.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     * @throws LintException when --rule was given an empty value
     */
    public function ruleIds(InputInterface $input): array
    {
        $ids = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getOption('rule')) ? $input->getOption('rule') : [] as $id) {
            if (!is_string($id) || trim($id) === '') {
                throw new LintException('Provide a rule id for --rule, such as --rule=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class.');
            }
            $ids[] = trim($id);
        }

        return $ids;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the paths given as arguments, relative to the configuration directory.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function paths(InputInterface $input): array
    {
        $paths = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getArgument('paths')) ? $input->getArgument('paths') : [] as $path) {
            if (is_string($path) && trim($path) !== '') {
                $paths[] = trim($path);
            }
        }

        return $paths;
    }

    /**
     * Writes one error to standard error, visible even under --quiet.
     */
    public function error(OutputInterface $output, string $message, string ...$hints): void
    {
        $errorOutput = $output instanceof ConsoleOutputInterface ? $output->getErrorOutput() : $output;
        $errorOutput->writeln(array_merge(['Decisions error: ' . $message], $hints), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW | OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_QUIET);
    }

    /**
     * Declares the --config option.
     */
    protected function addConfigOption(): void
    {
        $this->addOption('config', 'c', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Configuration file, relative to the working directory', self::DEFAULT_CONFIG);
    }

    /**
     * Declares the --format option with the formats a command supports.
     *
     * @param list<string> $formats
     */
    protected function addFormatOption(array $formats): void
    {
        $this->addOption('format', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Output format: ' . implode(', ', $formats) . '; defaults to ai in agent sessions');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the repeatable --rule option.
     */
    protected function addRuleOption(): void
    {
        $this->addOption('rule', 'r', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED | InputOption::VALUE_IS_ARRAY, 'Run only this rule id; repeat for several');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the optional paths argument.
     */
    protected function addPathsArgument(): void
    {
        $this->addArgument('paths', InputArgument::IS_ARRAY | InputArgument::OPTIONAL, 'Files, directories or globs relative to the configuration directory; defaults to the configured paths');
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command, reporting an invalid configuration, rule file or provider response.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        try {
            return $this->handle($input, $output);
        } catch (RuntimeException | JsonException $exception) {
            $this->error($output, $exception->getMessage());

            return self::INVALID;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Does the work of the command.
     *
     * @throws RuntimeException when the configuration, a rule file, an input or a provider response is invalid
     * @throws JsonException when a report cannot be encoded
     */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use DecisionsLint\Config\Configuration;
use DecisionsLint\Config\ConfigurationLoader;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Severity;
use DecisionsLint\Http\CurlTransport;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Lint\Linter;
use DecisionsLint\Lint\Planner;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\ProviderFactory;
use DecisionsLint\Reporting\ReporterFactory;
use JsonException;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Loads the configuration, plans the questions, asks the provider and writes the report.
 */
final class CheckRun
{
    /**
     * Creates a run that reaches the provider over a transport, or over cURL when none is given.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Runs a check and returns 1 when a finding reaches the failing severity, 0 otherwise.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths paths to lint instead of the configured ones, or empty
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds rule ids to run instead of every enabled rule, or empty
     * @param ?string $failOn the severity that fails the run, or null for the configured one
     * @throws LintException when the configuration, an input or the provider is invalid
     * @throws JsonException when the report cannot be encoded
     */
    public function run(string $configPath, string $format, array $paths, array $ruleIds, ?string $failOn, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $configuration = (new ConfigurationLoader())->load($configPath);
        $failOn = $this->failOn($failOn ?? $configuration->failOn);
        $plan = (new Planner())->plan($configuration, $paths, $ruleIds);
        $decision = (new ProviderFactory())->create($configuration->provider, $this->transport($configuration));
        $report = (new Linter())->lint($plan, $decision, $failOn);
        $output->write((new ReporterFactory())->create($format)->render($report, $output->isDecorated()), false, OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

        return $report->failed() ? 1 : 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the transport to use: the injected one, or cURL with the configured timeout and concurrency.
     */
    public function transport(Configuration $configuration): Transport
    {
        return $this->transport ?? new CurlTransport($configuration->provider->concurrency, $configuration->provider->timeout);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a failing severity, rejecting one that is not a severity or never.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the value is unknown
     */
    public function failOn(string $failOn): string
    {
        if ($failOn !== 'never' && !in_array($failOn, Severity::ALL, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --fail-on "%s". Use --fail-on=%s or never.', $failOn, implode(', ', Severity::ALL)));
        }

        return $failOn;
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Config\ConfigurationLoader;

/**
 * Checks decisions.yaml and rule files against their schemas and reports what each defines.
 */
final class ValidateCommand extends LintCommand
{
    /**
     * Creates the validate command for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory)
    {
        parent::__construct($directory, 'validate');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the description, options and arguments.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setDescription('Check the configuration and its imports, and any rule file given, against their schemas');
        $this->addConfigOption();
        $this->addArgument('files', InputArgument::IS_ARRAY | InputArgument::OPTIONAL, 'Rule files to validate on their own, relative to the working directory');
    }

    /**
     * Validates the configuration, then each rule file, and prints one line per document.
     *
     * @throws LintException when a document is missing, malformed or departs from its schema
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $configPath = $this->configPath($input);
        $configuration = (new ConfigurationLoader())->load($configPath);
        $enabled = count($configuration->activeRules());
        $output->writeln(sprintf('%s is valid: %d %s, %d enabled, provider %s (%s).', basename($configPath), count($configuration->rules), count($configuration->rules) === 1 ? 'rule' : 'rules', $enabled, $configuration->provider->name, $configuration->provider->model), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);
        $loader = new DocumentLoader();
        $reader = new RuleReader();
        foreach ($this->files($input) as $file) {
            $path = str_starts_with($file, '/') ? $file : $this->directory() . '/' . $file;
            $document = $loader->load($path, SchemaCatalog::RULES, $file);
            $rules = is_array($document['rules'] ?? null) ? $document['rules'] : [];
            foreach ($rules as $id => $definition) {
                $reader->read((string) $id, is_array($definition) ? ['source' => [$file]] + $this->mapping($definition) : []);
            }
            $output->writeln(sprintf('%s is valid: %d %s.', $file, count($rules), count($rules) === 1 ? 'rule' : 'rules'), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rule files given as arguments.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function files(InputInterface $input): array
    {
        $files = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getArgument('files')) ? $input->getArgument('files') : [] as $file) {
            if (is_string($file) && trim($file) !== '') {
                $files[] = trim($file);
            }
        }

        return $files;
    }

    /**
     * Reads an array as a mapping with string keys.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function mapping(array $value): array
    {
        $mapping = [];
        foreach ($value as $key => $entry) {
            $mapping[(string) $key] = $entry;
        }

        return $mapping;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\ProviderSettings;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Writes a starting decisions.yaml that imports the shipped rule files.
 */
final class InitCommand extends LintCommand
{
    /**
     * Creates the init command for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory, private ?string $rulesDirectory = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($directory, 'init');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the description and options.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setDescription('Create a decisions.yaml that imports the shipped rule files');
        $this->addConfigOption();
        $this->addOption('provider', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Decision API: ' . implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES), ProviderSettings::JEV);
        $this->addOption('path', 'p', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED | InputOption::VALUE_IS_ARRAY, 'Directory to lint; repeat for several', ['src']);
    }

    /**
     * Writes the configuration, refusing to overwrite one.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the file exists, the provider is unknown, or the file cannot be written
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $path = $this->configPath($input);
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s already exists. Edit it, or pass --config to write another file.', $path));
        }
        $provider = $input->getOption('provider');
        if (!is_string($provider) || !in_array($provider, ProviderSettings::NAMES, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --provider "%s". Use --provider=%s.', is_string($provider) ? $provider : '', implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES)));
        }
        $paths = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getOption('path')) ? $input->getOption('path') : [] as $entry) {
            if (is_string($entry) && trim($entry) !== '') {
                $paths[] = trim($entry);
            }
        }
        $content = $this->document(ProviderSettings::defaults($provider), $paths === [] ? ['src'] : $paths, $this->imports(dirname($path)));
        if (file_put_contents($path, $content) === false) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not write %s. Check the directory permissions.', $path));
        }
        $output->writeln(sprintf('Wrote %s. Export %s, review the imported rules with decisions-lint rules, then run decisions-lint check.', $path, ProviderSettings::defaults($provider)->apiKeyEnv), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the YAML of a starting configuration.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths
     * @param list<string> $imports
     */
    public function document(ProviderSettings $provider, array $paths, array $imports): string
    {
        $lines = [
            '# yaml-language-server: $schema=' . $this->schemaPath($imports),
            '# Nuanced rules judged by a decision model. Imported rules can be overridden below by id.',
            'version: 1',
            'provider:',
            '  name: ' . $provider->name,
            '  model: ' . $provider->model,
            '  api_key_env: ' . $provider->apiKeyEnv,
            'paths:',
        ];
        foreach ($paths as $entry) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $entry;
        }
        $lines[] = 'exclude: []';
        $lines[] = 'fail_on: error';
        $lines[] = $imports === [] ? 'imports: []' : 'imports:';
        foreach ($imports as $import) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $import;
        }
        $lines[] = 'rules: {}';

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Returns the shipped rule files as paths relative to the configuration directory.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function imports(string $directory): array
    {
        $rules = $this->rulesDirectory ?? dirname(__DIR__, 3) . '/rules';
        $vendor = $directory . '/vendor/k-kinzal/decisions-lint/rules';
        $prefix = is_dir($vendor) ? 'vendor/k-kinzal/decisions-lint/rules' : $this->relative($directory, $rules);
        $imports = [];
        foreach (glob($rules . '/*.yaml') ?: [] as $file) {
            $imports[] = $prefix . '/' . basename($file);
        }
        sort($imports);

        return $imports;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the schema path the editor hint points to, next to the imported rules.
     *
     * @param list<string> $imports
     */
    public function schemaPath(array $imports): string
    {
        return $imports === [] ? 'https://k-kinzal.github.io/php-ai-toolkit/decisions-lint/decisions.schema.json' : dirname(dirname($imports[0])) . '/schema/decisions.schema.json';
    }

    /**
     * Returns a path relative to a directory, using .. where needed.
     */
    public function relative(string $from, string $to): string
    {
        $fromParts = explode('/', trim((string) (realpath($from) ?: $from), '/'));
        $toParts = explode('/', trim((string) (realpath($to) ?: $to), '/'));
        while ($fromParts !== [] && $toParts !== [] && $fromParts[0] === $toParts[0]) {
            array_shift($fromParts);
            array_shift($toParts);
        }

        return implode('/', array_merge(array_fill(0, count($fromParts), '..'), $toParts));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\CheckCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\InitCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\LintCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\PlanCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\RulesCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\ValidateCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Application as ConsoleApplication;
use Symfony\Component\Console\CommandLoader\FactoryCommandLoader;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArrayInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputDefinition;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * The Symfony Console application with the check, plan, rules, validate and init commands.
 *
 * decisions-lint alone runs check, decisions-lint --help lists the commands,
 * and a command name it does not know exits 2.
 */
final class DecisionsConsole extends ConsoleApplication
{
    /**
     * The version the CLI reports.
     */
    public const VERSION = '1.0.0';

    /**
     * Creates the console for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory, ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
        parent::__construct('decisions-lint', self::VERSION);
        $this->setAutoExit(false);
        $this->setCommandLoader(new FactoryCommandLoader([
            'check' => static fn (): CheckCommand => new CheckCommand($directory, $transport),
            'plan' => static fn (): PlanCommand => new PlanCommand($directory),
            'rules' => static fn (): RulesCommand => new RulesCommand($directory),
            'validate' => static fn (): ValidateCommand => new ValidateCommand($directory),
            'init' => static fn (): InitCommand => new InitCommand($directory),
        ]));
        $this->setDefaultCommand('check');
    }

    /**
     * Returns the text decisions-lint list opens with.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function getHelp(): string
    {
        return $this->getLongVersion() . "\n\nJudges PHP code against nuanced rules with a decision model, as configured in decisions.yaml. Running decisions-lint without a command runs check.";
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command the input names.
     *
     * The input and output are configured here as well as in run(), so a
     * caller that runs the console in-process still gets --quiet, --verbose
     * and --no-ansi honoured. The verbosity Symfony Console leaves in the
     * environment is put back afterwards, so one in-process run does not
     * silence the next.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function doRun(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $shellVerbosity = [getenv('SHELL_VERBOSITY'), $_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] ?? null, $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] ?? null];
        $this->configureIO($input, $output);
        try {
            $name = $this->getCommandName($input);
            if ($name === null && $input->hasParameterOption(['--help', '-h'], true)) {
                return parent::doRun(new ArrayInput(['command' => 'list']), $output);
            }
            $problem = $name === null ? null : $this->unknownCommand($name);
            if ($problem !== null) {
                $errorOutput = $output instanceof ConsoleOutputInterface ? $output->getErrorOutput() : $output;
                $errorOutput->writeln(['Decisions error: ' . $problem, 'Run "decisions-lint list" to see the available commands.'], OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW | OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_QUIET);

                return LintCommand::INVALID;
            }

            return parent::doRun($input, $output);
        } finally {
            $this->restoreShellVerbosity(...$shellVerbosity);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Explains why a command name names no single command, or returns null when it does.
     */
    public function unknownCommand(string $name): ?string
    {
        $names = array_keys($this->all());
        if (in_array($name, $names, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        $matches = array_values(array_filter($names, static fn (string $command): bool => str_starts_with($command, $name) && !str_starts_with($command, '_')));
        if (count($matches) === 1) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($matches !== []) {
            sort($matches);

            return sprintf('Command "%s" is ambiguous. Name one of: %s.', $name, implode(', ', $matches));
        }
        $similar = array_values(array_filter($names, static fn (string $command): bool => !str_starts_with($command, '_') && levenshtein($name, $command) <= max(2, intdiv(strlen($name), 3))));

        return sprintf('Command "%s" is not defined.', $name) . ($similar === [] ? '' : sprintf(' Did you mean %s?', implode(' or ', $similar)));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the global options, with --help described the way decisions-lint treats it.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function getDefaultInputDefinition(): InputDefinition
    {
        $definition = parent::getDefaultInputDefinition();
        $options = $definition->getOptions();
        $options['help'] = new InputOption('help', 'h', InputOption::VALUE_NONE, 'Display help for the given command, or list the commands when none is given');
        $definition->setOptions(array_values($options));

        return $definition;
    }

    /**
     * Puts the shell verbosity of the environment back to what it was.
     *
     * @param false|string $process the process environment value, or false when unset
     * @param mixed $env the $_ENV value, or null when unset
     * @param mixed $server the $_SERVER value, or null when unset
     */
    public function restoreShellVerbosity($process, $env, $server): void
    {
        putenv($process === false ? 'SHELL_VERBOSITY' : 'SHELL_VERBOSITY=' . $process);
        unset($_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'], $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY']);
        if ($env !== null) {
            $_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] = $env;
        }
        if ($server !== null) {
            $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] = $server;
        }
    }
}

    public function console(): DecisionsConsole

     */
    public function output(): OutputInterface
    {
        return $this->output === null ? new ConsoleOutput() : new ClosureOutput($this->output);

    severity: warning
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class

      type: predicate
